_comment: Instance role for the EC2 host running the OTel Demo. Trust policy principal: ec2.amazonaws.com. Also attach the managed policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (Session Manager access). Bedrock for the agent (via LiteLLM) and, if the evaluation job runs on the host, for the evaluation model. osis:Ingest lets the Collector sign OTLP requests to the pipeline. Add the role to the collection's data access policy only if the evaluation job runs here.
